recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. The requested R5 publication change is present in current source, and further edits would only duplicate or disturb related clarifications from FHIR-13320 and FHIR-37990.
issue_request: FHIR-19673 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core search change request asking that the token search parameter documentation add the FHIR id datatype to the table of token-supported datatypes. The issue was raised for STU3, voted 7-0-0 on 2019-07-01, and applied for R5.
initial_application: Jira records PR https://github.com/HL7/fhir/pull/1428 as the application vehicle. That merged PR body lists FHIR-19673, and commit 85434c9aa29d1978aa68ed5e522d15fa3c3dbaa0 added the id row to source/search.html, even though the individual commit headline says FHIR-24864.
additional_context: The active source/fhir.ini [search-rules] section maps id=token. FHIR-13320 had already clarified _id token case-sensitivity, and FHIR-37990 later added id to the token code-only/no-pipe restriction. The Jira-linked Zulip thread and FHIR-I 2019-07-01 minutes both support the narrow table addition and do not identify a conflicting later decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was needed because source/search.html already lists ids in the token introduction, includes id in the token datatype table, restricts token parameters on id elements to the code segment only, and explains _id as token exact matching without a system.

related_jiras.note: Earlier Published/Persuasive issue clarified that _id token matching is case-sensitive, explaining why _id remains token rather than string.
Later Published/Persuasive issue added id to the token code-only/no-pipe restriction, refining but not reversing FHIR-19673.
